meta.name: software-design-philosophy
meta.description: Manage software complexity through deep modules, information hiding, and strategic programming. Use when the user mentions "module design", "API too complex", "shallow class", "complexity budget", "strategic vs tactical", "deep module", "information leakage", "pass-through method", "this code is over-engineered", or "simplify this design". Also trigger when reviewing an interface for simplicity, evaluating whether an abstraction is pulling its weight, deciding whether a comment is worth writing, or choosing between general-purpose and special-purpose approaches. Covers deep vs shallow modules, red flags for complexity, and comments as design documentation. For code quality, see clean-code. For architecture boundaries, see clean-architecture.

copy.tagline: 简化软件设计，降低系统复杂度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常为模块边界和接口复杂度困扰
copy.tagline_en: Simplify software design and reduce system complexity
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often struggle with module boundaries and interface complexity

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析你的软件设计，评估模块深度、信息隐藏和复杂度，并给出改进建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“模块设计”、“API 太复杂”、“浅层类”、“复杂度预算”等关键词，或要求审查接口、评估抽象时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这个模块接口是否太复杂。
say.note: Claude 会评估接口深度并给出简化建议。

say.text: 这段代码有信息泄露吗？
say.note: Claude 会检查模块间是否共享了不该共享的知识。

say.text: 这个设计是战略性的还是战术性的？
say.note: Claude 会分析设计投入是否足够，并建议改进。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes your software design, evaluates module depth, information hiding, and complexity, and provides improvement suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "module design", "API too complex", "shallow class", "complexity budget", or when you ask to review an interface or evaluate an abstraction.

say_en.text: Review this module interface for complexity.
say_en.note: Claude will assess interface depth and suggest simplifications.

say_en.text: Is there information leakage in this code?
say_en.note: Claude will check if modules share knowledge they shouldn't.

say_en.text: Is this design strategic or tactical?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze design effort and suggest improvements.
